name: pausable-image
title: Pausable image
description: An animated GIF or WebP that starts still behind a Play button, so moving images meet the rule for pause, stop and hide. Reduced motion always starts paused.
docs: src is the animated file (GIF, animated WebP or APNG, or an animated SVG) and alt is required. Without poster the first frame of src is drawn to a canvas as the still, which loads src up front; with poster nothing animated is requested until Play. The button is one element with aria-pressed, so focus stays on it when it turns from Play into the corner Pause. autoPlay is ignored for a visitor who prefers reduced motion. It is the pause control WCAG 2.2.2 asks for when motion lasts more than five seconds. onPlayingChange reports the state.
